name: openmenu
description: OpenMenu is a desktop application for managing POS/Retails/Restaurants/Services Sale/Invoicing.

scripts.upload: node -r dotenv/config -e "console.log('Uploading executable...'); require('child_process').execSync('curl --verbose --header \"PRIVATE-TOKEN: ' + process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN + '\" --upload-file dist/OpenMenu.exe \"https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/' + process.env.CI_PROJECT_ID + '/packages/generic/openmenu-desktop/release/OpenMenu.exe\"', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('Uploading latest.yml...'); if (!require('fs').existsSync('dist/latest.yml')) { console.error('Error: latest.yml file is missing in the dist directory.'); process.exit(1); } require('child_process').execSync('curl --verbose --header \"PRIVATE-TOKEN: ' + process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN + '\" --upload-file dist/latest.yml \"https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/' + process.env.CI_PROJECT_ID + '/packages/generic/openmenu-desktop/release/latest.yml\"', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('Upload complete.');"

author: Atta Rasul
